stem:
At the beginning of September, Mr. Watkins had 543 erasers.

• During September he gave his students 99 of the erasers.
• During October he gave his students 212 of the erasers.

How many erasers did Mr. Watkins have at the end of October?
visual_elements: text showing problem statement and answer options F, G, H, J
difficulty_rationale: The problem involves simple subtraction steps applied sequentially to find the remaining quantity but does not involve complex reasoning or multiple concepts.
